authority: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
verified_rules: the current 1m composite DTM covers approximately 99 percent of England
the DTM removes surface objects from the DSM using algorithms and manual editing to represent bare terrain
the 2022 composite combines Time Stamped archive and National LIDAR Programme surveys
repeat coverage uses the newest best-resolution survey and resampled data uses bilinear interpolation
the composite survey dates range from 6 June 2000 to 2 April 2022
GeoTIFF rasters are delivered in 5km tiles aligned to the OS National Grid
values are metres referenced to Ordnance Survey Newlyn using OSTN15
individual surveys entering the composite have plus or minus 15cm RMSE vertical accuracy
the metadata index identifies which survey contributed at each location
time-stamped DTM tiles are available at 25cm 50cm 1m and 2m and record survey date resolution transformation and geoidal model
the current catalogue exposes WCS WMS WMTS OGC API Features and metadata-index links
older composite releases are explicitly retired and must not silently replace the current dataset
quality_gate: PASS for elevation lineage and vertical-reference semantics; BLOCKED for candidate-specific raster cells
